posts: Reminder: a treasury policy beats a treasury vote. Write down your runway target, diversification rules, and spending thresholds before the next proposal forces the question. Governance by document > governance by panic. #sputnik #dao

replies.text: This is the whole case for DAO treasuries. Runway measured in years, not vibes — that's how councils ship through the quiet macro instead of forced-selling at the bottom. #dao
Same math any DAO parking treasury in LPs should run: APR is the headline, IL is the hidden expense line. Model the chop case before the vote, not after.
